[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45522/45522-1777299985-2094955074.png[/img]

[center]Receive a gift by mail at every friendship level with Vincent[/center]
[center]Finally… a reason to befriend the village’s most energetic small human.[/center]
[center]Make friends with Vincent and receive gifts that are exactly what you’d expect from a kid (and occasionally something surprisingly useful). From random stuff to “where did he even get this?”, every friendship level brings a new surprise.[/center]
[center]Let’s be honest—you’re probably doing him a favor just by listening to him talk.[/center]
[center]But hey, free stuff is free stuff![/center]
